verdict.rationale: Hightouch's official MCP server lets an AI assistant build audiences in plain language and exposes the customer schema, which implies schema-grounded segment creation. The built-in agent is documented only for exploring segments, not building them. No documentation shows a draft segment definition being surfaced for human review before it is saved or activated. missing for 10: documented review/approval step for AI-generated segment definitions, explicit evidence that generation is grounded in the user's actual schema (rather than just schema access being available), native in-app NL audience building, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.
